messages.text: Reviewer B: I checked the proposal against the limit of 20. 19 passes, but 21 exceeds the limit, so the prior note that all values pass is incorrect. With the proposed values [19, 21], the change does not meet the requirement that every value be <= 20. I cannot approve as-is. Please update the proposed values to 20 or below before we can approve.

I agree. I independently checked the proposed values [19, 21] against the limit of 20. 19 passes, but 21 exceeds the limit, so the prior note that all values pass is incorrect. The requirement is that every proposed value must be <= 20, and this change does not meet that as-is. I cannot approve it. Please update the proposed values to 20 or below, especially changing 21 to 20 or less, and resubmit. I will not sign off until that defect is fixed.
